theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · exact ChoiceBisim.choice h
  · intro s1 s2 r μ
    constructor
    · intro s1' htr
      cases r with
      | choice p q r hbisim =>
        obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
        cases htr with
        | choiceL _ _ _ htr =>
          obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
          exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL htr2, ChoiceBisim.bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
        | choiceR _ _ _ htr =>
          exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
      | bisim hbisim =>
        obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exact ⟨s2', htr2, ChoiceBisim.bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
    · intro s2' htr
      cases r with
      | choice p q r hbisim =>
        obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
        cases htr with
        | choiceL _ _ _ htr =>
          obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
          exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL htr1, ChoiceBisim.bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1)⟩
        | choiceR _ _ _ htr =>
          exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim HomBisimilarity.refl⟩
      | bisim hbisim =>
        obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exact ⟨s1', htr1, ChoiceBisim.bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1)⟩
